questions.stem: What is the sign of the enthalpy change (ΔH) for an exothermic reaction?

options.text: Positive, because energy is gained by the reaction
Zero, because energy is neither gained nor lost
Negative, because energy is released to the surroundings
It depends on whether a catalyst is used

questions.explanation: Exothermic reactions always have a negative ΔH value because the products have less energy than the reactants. The energy difference is released to the surroundings.
